description: IRC Section 280F passenger automobile depreciation limits by tax year

2024.notes: 60% bonus depreciation available in 2024, Rev. Proc. 2023-34

2026.notes: 20% bonus depreciation available in 2026 (projected, subject to IRS confirmation)

applicability.definition: Passenger automobiles are 4-wheeled vehicles manufactured primarily for use on public streets/roads, with unloaded gross vehicle weight of 6,000 lbs or less
exclusions: Vehicles with GVWR > 6,000 lbs (may be subject to SUV Section 179 caps instead)
Vehicles not designed primarily for personal use (ambulances, hearses, taxis, delivery vehicles)
Trucks and vans rated at > 6,000 lbs GVWR

notes: These are annual depreciation caps including all methods (MACRS, bonus, §179)
Limits apply separately to each vehicle
Year 1 limit includes bonus depreciation if elected and available
If bonus not elected, use year1_noBonus limit
Limits are for 100% business use; prorate for mixed use
Used passenger autos acquired before 9/28/2017 may have different rules
